description: I’ve given myself one mission: complete a long-distance triathlon at IRONMAN Calella in October 2027. I want to respect the distance and bring a prepared version of myself to the start line. The goal is to learn as much as possible, train with consistency, and enjoy a race I will have earned.
imageAlt: Grid placeholder for the challenge banner
goal: Arrive prepared enough to enjoy the race I worked for.

roadmap.title: Learn
roadmap.text: Understand the three sports, the body and the habits that make training repeatable.

roadmap.title: Build
roadmap.text: Stack consistent weeks. Add volume with patience and make room for recovery.

roadmap.title: Sharpen
roadmap.text: Bring in race-specific work when the foundation is ready.

roadmap.title: Race
roadmap.text: Reduce the volume before race day, reach the start line prepared and enjoy the experience.

trainingNote: Build consistency first. Learn the three sports, keep easy sessions easy, add volume with patience and let race-specific intensity arrive when the foundation is ready.
sponsorText: Interested in supporting the journey? Get in touch to talk about a collaboration that fits the project and the story behind it.
distanceDescription: The long-distance format I’m working towards. These are race distances, not completed training totals.
